title: Dialogue v1.1
description: Character dialogue document for multi-voice TTS stitch jobs. Books (single-voice long text) are a separate job type and are not represented by this schema.

id.description: Stable identifier for this dialogue document.

title.description: Optional human-readable title shown in the UI.

characters.description: Character configuration (not audio assets). Character ids must be unique within this array.

defaultGapMs.description: Product default silence (ms) inserted after each turn before the next. Not a user Settings slider.

turns.description: Ordered list of dialogue turns. Each turn becomes one TTS chunk in the stitch job.

id.description: Unique character identifier referenced by turns.

voiceId.description: Reference to a user-cloned voice that is ready for generation. If the voice is missing at generate time, the turn/job status is blocked. No silent fallback.

color.description: Hex color for the character chip in the UI (e.g. #0D9488).

speed.description: Default playback speed multiplier for this character.

pitch.description: Default pitch multiplier for this character.

avatarId.description: Visual-only avatar reference. UI defaults: avatar-neutro, avatar-uomo, avatar-donna, avatar-bambino, avatar-anziano, avatar-custom. Sample extras avatar-01 through avatar-04 may exist but are not required. Missing avatar renders initials on a teal circle.

id.description: Stable identifier for this turn within the dialogue.

characterId.description: Must match the id of a character in characters[].

text.description: Utterance text for this turn (1–4000 characters).

gapMs.description: Optional override: silence in milliseconds after this turn before the next. Last turn: ignored or 0.

speed.description: Optional per-turn speed override (inherits character speed when omitted).
